Anyone watch these shows? I just started binge watching them with my girlfriend and I've been pretty surprised by how much I liked them since I was never a huge fan of Smallville. The Flash is really well done and the way they do comic villains in Arrow is (most of the time) really cool. Suicide Squad scenes in Arrow are some of my favorite and very interested to see what direction they take for HIVE.

Also. Ra's Al Ghul is Bad. Ass.

I binged on Arrow season 1 on Netflix, and was super impatient for season 2 to come out.  I still haven't gotten through season 2 yet for some reason - it just isn't grabbing me as well as the first.  I'm watching Flash on Hulu, and am a little regretful that I'm not current on Arrow because of occasional cross referencing...so clearly I need to watch more Arrow and catch up.

I don't have good knowledge of the original characters, so I'm just enjoying the stories as-is.  I like the way the two shows are handling different levels of hero/villain power, though I'm really curious to see how the metahuman landscape changes in Arrow as time goes on.
